title: 第2章 林知渔，又死了
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林知渔觉得肯定是自己被当成了真千金，家人宠爱了二十多年，所以养成了这种蛮横骄纵却又嫉恶如仇的性子。

她可以直接逃跑的。

但最后，林知渔还是跑回房，用力推开男人，“你放开她！”

男人突然阴森地笑了起来，“杀一个也是杀，杀两个也是顺手的事。”他一把掐住了林知渔的脖子，而后将她整个人往窗户边拉扯。

“钱海！你疯了？！”

余时夏拿起床边的玻璃杯，冲过去，狠狠地砸向了男人的脑袋。

“该死……”男人被彻底地惹怒了，他疼着痛，将林知渔整个人往窗外压。

余时夏张嘴就咬在了男人的手腕处。

“啊！”

男人愤怒地抬起一脚踹在了余时夏的肚子上，他松开了林知渔，转而将魔爪伸向了余时夏。

余时夏下意识想跑，却被身后之人扯住了长发，狠狠地将她整个人摔向了一旁。

后脑勺撞在了尖锐的桌角，余时夏倒在了地上，不动了。

而后钱海扭过头，阴森森地看着林知渔。

“杀人是犯法的，你，你……”

话还没说完，林知渔的脖子就被他掐住了。随后，钱海的另一只手抓起了她的腿，在她惊恐的表情之中，整个人无法挣脱地被推出了窗外。

“去死吧！”

林知渔感觉自己在不停地下坠，尖锐的风啸刺耳，视野里高楼墙面飞速向上倒退，天空好像被拉扯得扭曲模糊……

她瞪着死气沉沉的双眼望着天，肢体以一种诡异的角度弯曲着，血液自她身下缓缓漫开。

林知渔，又死了。

“呼……”

床上的人再一次坐了起来。

这是林知渔醒来的唯一感受。

那种巨大的冲击力造成的全身骨折，内脏破裂的剧烈疼痛过于清晰了，导致她现在还感觉自己的四肢都在抽痛。

缓过神的林知渔从床上坐了起来，拿起手机开始搜索余时夏的消息。

微博上，余时夏在一分钟前发布了一条简短的微博：

Page (1/3)

Lin Zhiyu felt that he must have been treated as a real daughter and pampered by his family for more than 20 years, so he developed such an overbearing and arrogant but jealous temper.

She could just run away.

But in the end, Lin Zhiyu ran back to the room and pushed the man away, "Let her go!"

The man suddenly laughed sinisterly, "Killing one is killing, killing two is easy." He grabbed Lin Zhiyu's neck, and then pulled her towards the window.

"Qian Hai! Are you crazy?!"

Yu Shixia picked up the glass beside the bed, rushed over, and hit the man on the head hard.

"Damn..." The man was completely angered. He was in pain and pressed Lin Zhiyu out of the window.

Yu Shixia opened her mouth and bit the man's wrist.

"Ah!"

The man angrily kicked Yu Shixia in the stomach. He let go of Lin Zhiyu and extended his claws towards Yu Shixia.

Yu Shixia subconsciously wanted to run, but the person behind her grabbed her hair and threw her to the side.

The back of his head hit the sharp corner of the table, and Yu Shixia fell to the ground, motionless.

Then Qian Hai turned his head and looked at Lin Zhiyu gloomily.

"It's illegal to kill someone, you, you..."

Before he finished speaking, Lin Zhiyu's neck was strangled by him.Then, Qian Hai's other hand grabbed her leg, and with her frightened expression, she was pushed out of the window unable to escape.

"Go to hell!"

Lin Zhiyu felt like he was falling continuously. The sharp wind whistling was harsh. The walls of high-rise buildings in his field of vision were rapidly retreating upwards. The sky seemed to be pulled into a distorted and blurred state...

She stared at the sky with lifeless eyes, her limbs were bent at a strange angle, and blood slowly spread out from under her body.

Lin Zhiyu died again.

"Huh..."

The person on the bed sat up again.

This was Lin Zhiyu's only feeling when he woke up.

The severe pain of broken bones and ruptured internal organs caused by the huge impact was too clear, causing her to still feel throbbing pain in her limbs.

After regaining consciousness, Lin Zhiyu sat up from the bed, picked up his phone and started searching for Yu Shixia's news.

On Weibo, Yu Shixia posted a short Weibo message a minute ago:
